intent: Prove transport health before evaluating scale-out collective efficiency.

semantics.rdma_tx_discards: loss/error signal; acceptance threshold must be declared
semantics.rdma_rx_errors: receive error signal; acceptance threshold must be declared
semantics.roce_ecn_marked: congestion signal, not an unconditional failure by itself
semantics.roce_cnp_sent: congestion-control signal, not an unconditional failure by itself
semantics.pfc_rx_pause_duration: flow-control pressure signal; interpret with duration/rate and workload context

stages.baseline_policy: compare measured collective performance against an explicit topology/reference baseline; no repository-wide magic bandwidth threshold

pending_site_baselines: RDMA discard/error tolerance and observation window
ECN/CNP congestion envelope under declared load
PFC pause-duration envelope under declared load
NCCL bus bandwidth by collective, message size, node count, rail/topology, and placement
